user: Looking back, why was White stuck passing so many times in a row near the end? I don't fully get why it couldn't move even though it had way more discs than me.
assistant:
White had to pass because in Othello a move is legal only if it **flanks at least one opponent disc** between the disc you place and another of your discs; just having lots of discs doesn’t matter if no empty square creates a flip.  

The deciding feature was **mobility**: near the end, your moves left White with many discs but **no legal flanking lines**, so White’s turn was skipped until a later Black move created one. That’s why endgames often favor moves that leave the opponent **few or zero legal replies**, even if they don’t flip many discs immediately.
